init_hook: # Per-machine configuration, if there is any. Sourced rather than declared
# with env_from, because env_from refuses to start when the file is absent
# and a clean checkout has none. First, so everything below it defaults
# around what this file already set.
# Toolchain caches live in the checkout, not in $HOME. This repo is
# self-contained, and a sandboxed run cannot write outside its root: the
# default locations fail with EPERM and take `just check` with them.
# One port block for this project, so two checkouts never fight. 9466 is
# "wimm" on a keypad; it is deliberately nowhere near 5173, 8080 or 3000,
# because a port one transposition from a framework default gets mistyped.
# Postgres claims no port at all: it listens on a Unix socket (bin/db).
# The scheme follows the certificate, because the certificate is what
# decides whether the dev server serves TLS. Two facts that must agree,
# derived from one: WebAuthn validates the origin, so a base URL still
# saying http while vite serves https rejects every passkey ceremony.
# A per-checkout operator credential, minted into .devbox on first use.
